title: No Orphan Approvals
control_description: Every exception must have a named owner written justification expiry and second review above threshold
notes: Start with refunds access changes and vendor exceptions

title: Two-Person Rule for Irreversible Actions
control_description: Require independent second approval for irreversible actions above defined thresholds
notes: Thresholds must be documented and reviewed

title: Independent QA Sampling
control_description: Sample independently and randomly with documented methodology and visible findings
